target_customer: Small teams and individuals who want AI agents to do repeatable jobs in the browser and apps on their own computer
problem: General AI assistants are not reliable at one specific recurring job; the company trains agents around a single job with its own tools, memory, schedules, rules and approval gates.
business_model: Free open source (MIT) desktop software with a team option and self-hosted deployment; paid pricing not public
product_category: AI agents, browser and desktop automation

founders.name: Tim Jang
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: previously at Block. Education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable browser and desktop agents need model orchestration, browser control and approval flows; hard parts are reliability, not research.

defensibility.rationale: The product is open source under the MIT license and the agent category attracted many entrants and model vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Model vendors later shipped browser and computer agents; no source shows an acquisition of Opensteer.

market_need_then: Interest in LLM agents surged in 2023, but no source found documents customer demand for Opensteer specifically.

branding.domain_note: Uses opensteer.com; acquisition history not found. Site copyright holder is TrendUp AI, Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain pitch: turn a Mac into AI coworkers

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand coverage found; third party directories give it a very low score.

pivots.to: Free open source Mac app running agents on the user's own computer (current site)
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from comparing the YC page and the current site, exact date unknown

outcome_analysis: Opensteer is a one person company that remains listed as active, with no confirmed funding, customers or press. Its product has shifted from cloud hosted specialized agents to a free open source Mac application, but the timing is not public, so the story is too thin to assign success or failure factors.
notes: Dealroom snippet shows a seed of about 125K USD with no investor visible; unverified, not recorded as a round. StartupHub lists status Inactive while YC says Active. No dated 2023 competitors found; search returned only current aggregator comparisons. Education not found. Team size 1 per YC. Completeness pass: one round recorded on the strength of a single database or outlet, Dealroom alone, with no date or investor shown. No primary announcement found.
